expectations.text: Detects the dependency problem: new phase (between 1-2) requires webhook delivery from Phase 4 which doesn't exist yet
expectations.evidence: Says 'Critical dependency conflict identified. The new Analytics Dashboard phase needs to aggregate delivery metrics from the webhook delivery service. The webhook delivery service is created in Phase 4.'

expectations.text: Does NOT silently insert the phase with a forward dependency that can't be satisfied
expectations.evidence: Says 'I will not update the plan until this conflict is resolved.' Plan not modified.

expectations.text: Explains why the requested position is problematic (Phase 4 must complete before analytics can aggregate its metrics)
expectations.evidence: Says 'This is an impossible dependency ordering: the Analytics Dashboard cannot aggregate metrics from a service that has not been built yet.'

expectations.text: Proposes alternatives: move the new phase after Phase 4, or split it into phases (basic metrics after Phase 2, webhook metrics after Phase 4)
expectations.evidence: Three options: 1) Move after Phase 4, 2) Scope down to Phase 1 metrics only, 3) Reorder phases to move webhook earlier.
